content.text: The "empty-all" test case was mis-designed (array size is 3, so `const False` correctly filters). Let me fix it and add a true zero-size aggregate case:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp/tests && python3 - <<'EOF'
p = 't6_expr.py'
s = open(p).read()
s = s.replace('''check("empty-all", ["all", "v", ["field", ["var", "b"], "arr"], ["const", "B", False]],
      objs(ms(""), A, 1, 2, 0, 1), "READY")''',
'''check("const-all", ["all", "v", ["field", ["var", "b"], "arr"], ["const", "B", True]],
      objs(ms(""), A, 1, 2, 0, 1), "READY")''')
s = s.replace('''# 10. char/enum via nested? skip. match classes/escapes
check("match-class", ["match", ["var", "s"], "[0-9a-f]*x?y" ] if False else ["match", ["var", "s"], "[0-9a-f]*[!-~]"],
      objs(ms("beef\\x00s"), A, 1, 2, 0, 1), "READY")''',
'''# 10. match classes over recovered string
check("match-class", ["match", ["var", "s"], "[0-9a-f]*[!-~]"],
      objs(ms("beef\\x00s"), A, 1, 2, 0, 1), "READY")

# 11. zero-length aggregates: reserve their own ID; empty all is true
ztypes = types + [
    {"name": "Arr0", "kind": "array", "element": "N8", "size": 0},
    {"name": "Str0", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 0},
    {"name": "Zero", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["e", "Arr0"], ["s", "Str0"]]},
]
zmod = {"name": "z", "params": [["z", "Zero"], ["n", "N8"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
        "requires": ["and",
            ["all", "v", ["field", ["var", "z"], "e"], ["const", "B", False]],
            ["eq", ["field", ["var", "z"], "s"], ["const", "Str0", ""]]]}
# layout: z struct x0; e arr x1 (no children); s buffer x2 (no chars); n x3; r x4 -> variables 5
zcamp = {"types": ztypes, "modules": [zmod], "calls": [], "pipes": [],
         "entries": ["z"], "machine": None,
         "runs": [{"entry": "z", "ktest": b64(ktest([("x3", le(9, 1)), ("x4", le(1, 1))]))}]}
zout = run_campaign(zcamp)
zplan = zout['plans'][0]
assert zplan['slots'] == [["x3", ["n"], 1], ["x4", ["r"], 1]], zplan
assert zplan['variables'] == 5, zplan
assert zout['records'] == [{'status': 'READY', 'case': 0, 'model_result': True}], zout
assert zout['corpus'][0]['inputs'] == {"z": {"e": [], "s": ""}, "n": 9}
# composite IDs x0..x2 must NOT appear; they do not. A KTEST with x0 present is invalid:
zcamp2 = dict(zcamp)
zcamp2['runs'] = [{"entry": "z", "ktest": b64(ktest([("x0", b''), ("x3", le(9, 1)), ("x4", le(1, 1))]))}]
assert run_campaign(zcamp2)['records'] == [{'status': 'INVALID_TEST'}]''')
open(p, 'w').write(s)
EOF
python3 t6_expr.py
